params.message:
Add a study mode to the voice bridge

POST /session {mode: "study", course} mints a realtime conversation whose
instructions and tools come from the study service on the workbench, and
only its three tools (study_next, study_answer, study_command). Tool calls
of such a conversation are carried to the study service's routes of the
same name; any other name is refused, and a brief that offers another tool
is refused before a session is minted. The work voice is minted exactly as
before when no mode is given.

A study conversation has its own id and stays out of the work timeline, the
transcripts and the memory consolidation, and hears no agent notices.

The session is minted with a capped conversation window (truncation by
retention ratio). POST /usage takes the usage the realtime API reported to
the page or app into a monthly ledger priced at list price, counted once
per event id, and a monthly cap on study usage refuses a new study session
with a sentence the phone can show. GET /study lists the courses with the
month's amount and cap.

The study service address and the course list come from the environment,
never from the caller. The OpenAI key stays sealed to the bridge; the study
service holds none.
